channel.title: mint - companies
channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: Sunil Mittal takes on Elon Musk, says Bharti is ahead of Starlink, ready to launch
item.description: According to Sunil Bharti Mittal, his company is ahead of Starlink in India’s satellite approval queue, with its network and satellites ready but security clearances still pending.&nbsp;

item.title: ‘AI was a monster’: Kumar Mangalam Birla reveals strategy behind investing in artificial intelligence
item.description: Aditya Birla Group chairman Kumar Mangalam Birla says global crises, shifting trade policies and changing demand are complicating investment decisions, but businesses must keep growing.&nbsp;

item.title: Why Zoho's Sridhar Vembu is trending after ‘pay hike, mass layoff’ tweet: Losing 80% clients, making mega business, more
item.description: Vembu started building what came to be known “Zoho” in the 1990s, in a small apartment located in the suburbs of Chennai. The startup had its own share of struggles and achievements. Here's the story of Zoho – how it became a billion-dollar company.

item.title: Who is Neville Tata? Why is he in the news today? Latest developments in Tata Trust dispute explained
item.description: The latest development in the Tata Trust dispute concerns Noel’s leadership and Neville’s appointment, with other trustees raising objections with regulators.&nbsp;

item.title: M Pallonji backed Protec General secures around ₹300 crore to expand operations
item.description: The capital infusion follows Protec’s in-principle regulatory approval. Existing investor Federal Bank also participated as the insurer prepares to expand its operations.

item.title: Blackstone plans to double India investments to $100 billion: Where will the money go
item.description: Blackstone plans to double its India investments to $100 billion over five years, targeting real estate, digital infrastructure, financial services, healthcare and manufacturing.

item.title: Bank of Baroda responds to BR Shetty lawsuit in Bombay HC, clarifies it has not received court papers
item.description: Bank of Baroda responds to BR Shetty's $15 billion lawsuit in the Bombay High Court, saying it has not received court papers. Here's what the case alleges.

item.title: AI startup with 12 million users faces bankruptcy: Why Character.AI failed to make money
item.description: Despite about 12 million active users, Character.AI loses up to $9 million monthly. Disney has agreed to bid $20 million for a licence to its intellectual property.

item.title: Hyundai, TVS ready electric mini-truck to rival Tata Ace in 2027
item.description: The entry will expand TVS’s automotive ambitions beyond two- and three-wheelers, while giving Hyundai a foothold in India’s commercial vehicle market beyond passenger cars.

item.title: Zoho’s pay freeze signals broader AI-led pressures for India’s software industry
item.description: Zoho’s profitability has come under pressure since FY23, the year OpenAI brought generative AI into the mainstream with the launch of ChatGPT in November 2022. While Zoho’s profitability rose 3% in FY23, its employee costs jumped 49%.

item.title: Blackstone in talks to invest $400-500 million in defence tech firm Accord
item.description: Founded in 1991 by five engineers with experience in avionics and real-time embedded systems, Accord has evolved from a software developer into a specialist in global navigation satellite systems (GNSS). It makes satellite navigation devices, specialised computer chips and electronic systems.

item.title: Rising costs put logistics firms under pressure this festive season
item.description: With logistics providers revising rates, brands may increasingly rethink discounting, delivery fees and fulfilment strategies as they navigate margin pressures.

item.title: Employee arrested after listening device found in OpenAI conference room, FBI and the company say
item.description: Employee arrested after listening device found in OpenAI conference room, FBI and the company say

item.title: Blackstone’s AI Data Center Deals Are Looking Shaky
item.description: In a capital-intensive industry where money is the weapon that catapults startups to scale and overwhelms rivals, financiers can have a lot of sway.

item.title: KL Rahul-backed Boldfit secures $42 million to boost retail presence across India
item.description: Founded in 2018 by Pallav Bihani, Boldfit offers a range of products, including sportswear, athletic footwear, sports equipment and fitness accessories.
